info.title: Rotpunkt Übersetzungstool
info.description:
Browser-based AI translation tool for kitchen-industry documents (glossary-aware, human-in-the-loop).

**Workflow:** upload → preview → highlight terms → edit → quality check → approve → export → archive.

Log in via **Authorize** (demo users: `admin/admin123`, `reviewer/reviewer123`, `translator/translator123`).

delete.description:
Projects, approvals, exports and glossary changes store who made them as text, so they keep the name. The name is
retired: a new account with it could otherwise pass for the author of that work. The caller stays an admin, so
deleting never leaves the application without one.

put.summary: Accept findings as they are (or reopen them with [])
put.description:
A judgment call (a long translation, a different number of line breaks, an ambiguous term) can be accepted;
an error (a missing translation, a broken glossary term) cannot, it has to be fixed.

post.description: Stores the final translation as a release (history). Export is only possible afterwards.
